verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a robotics framework, but the evidence shows no first-party natural-language interface. The docs describe only structured `ros2` CLI sub-commands and programmatic client libraries. One community note that LLMs handle ROS boilerplate well is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
